actions.action: Check soil moisture 5 cm deep and look for drainage hole and standing water
If soil is dry, water until it runs out the bottom
Water only when top 5 cm feels dry
If soil is wet, slide out root ball and inspect roots
If roots are mushy, trim rotten roots with alcohol-wiped scissors
Repot in a pot with drainage hole using fresh potting mix
Cut off blackened leaves at the base
Move plant within 1 m of a bright window out of direct midday sun

reason: The answer names overwatering and root rot as the main cause. Its plan to check the roots, trim the rot and fix drainage matches the fix that worked, though it repots in soil rather than water-propagating. Its watering advice is protected by a soil check, so nothing is harmful.
